observations.statement: The frozen module (self-hash 5d2509f6..., byte-identical to the prereg.md#10 block) ran --stage all on 2026-10-17T15:10:35Z and completed 35/35 offline controls, the observation-0 fetch-complete census (1119 rows written, 1107 HTTP 200, 6x HTTP 404, 6 transport errors, 36.59 s), the 360 s separation, the observation-1 re-fetch of all 1107 admitted pages (1107/1107 HTTP 200), the 10 self-pairs and the 10 control-probe fetches.

The frozen module then raised ValueError in parent_window() (strptime pattern %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ vs the real timestamp 2026-10-17T00:45:32.184Z) at 2026-10-17T15:18:18Z, i.e. while entering the SECONDARY B-RETRO-LONG-DT channel, after all primary RAW evidence had been written and before derived/metrics.json and derived/decision.json existed.

derived/metrics.json and derived/decision.json in this packet were produced by importing the unmodified frozen module and replaying its own pure summarize()/decide() over its own RAW rows; the only values not produced by that replay are M-WALL-S, M-PARTIAL, M-TIME-TRUNCATED-HOSTS and the GET ledger, which are reconstructed from the frozen run own checkpoints and disclosed in derived/metrics.json#reconstruction_notes.
All three frozen positive-control URLs changed on the primary text channel between the two observations (cloudflare cdn-cgi/trace, api.github.com/rate_limit, timeapi.io current zone).

Both frozen null anchors (example.com, www.iana.org/domains/reserved) returned HTTP 200 at both observations with zero text change; all 10 in-frame self-pairs were text- and byte-stable with a maximum intra-pair gap of 0.006 s.
Zero of the 1107 observation-1 re-fetches failed: censoring is 0/1107, so no page was right-censored, no page returned 404/410, and none was rate-limited at observation 1.

Measured separations of the 1107 eligible pairs: min 377.06 s, median 407.97 s, p90 430.52 s, max 439.83 s; 0 pairs fell below the frozen DT_MIN_S floor of 300 s and the maximum is far below DT_MAX_S=900 s.
Zero of 1107 pairs changed on the primary structural-text channel: k_text=0 in the deep stratum (n=686) and k_text=0 in the shallow stratum (n=421), and 0 in every URL class.
7 of 1107 pairs changed on the byte channel (3 deep, 4 shallow) while none changed on the text channel; all 7 are therefore attribute-only or script-only churn under the frozen canonicalisation.

359 of 1107 pairs (219 deep, 140 shallow) show an ETag or Last-Modified difference while their canonical text is unchanged - the exact asymmetry the pre-2.0 cycle-8 finding warned about, reproduced on real HTML pages at scale.

The observation-0 frame reproduces the frozen DESIGN sweep almost exactly: deep 686 / shallow 421 (DESIGN: 686/421), 1107 admitted (DESIGN: 1107), 1119 rows (DESIGN: 1119), all four hosts in both strata, 0 truncated bodies.

A first launch of the same frozen command at 15:08:30Z completed its observation-0 census (1119 rows, 1107 admitted, 40.16 s) and was then killed during the separation by the orchestration shell timeout, not by the experiment; the recorded transaction is the complete second launch at 15:10:35Z.

validity_notes: RECONSTRUCTION (disclosed, load-bearing): the frozen module could not write derived/metrics.json or derived/decision.json because it raised ValueError in parent_window() while entering the SECONDARY retro channel. Those two files were produced by importing the byte-identical unmodified frozen module and replaying its own pure summarize()/decide() over its own RAW rows. No frozen file was edited: freeze.json artifact_hashes and hashes were all re-verified OK before and after execution. V1-CODE-IDENTITY holds (5d2509f691193c610a9797e4c473ee9425c010c1a4bd35f65b43e3aca672c573).

RECONSTRUCTED FIELDS: M-WALL-S (463.32 s, from frozen PROGRESS.started_utc 2026-10-17T15:10:35.398909Z to process death 2026-10-17T15:18:18.715476Z), M-PARTIAL (false), M-TIME-TRUNCATED-HOSTS (0, because all four hosts swept concurrently inside a 36.59 s observation-0 wall, far below the frozen PER_HOST_WALL_S=150 s) and the observation-1/total GET ledger (2268) are reconstructions from the frozen run own checkpoints and raw rows, not values emitted by the frozen process. Every disclosure is in derived/metrics.json#reconstruction_notes.

TWO INDEPENDENT FROZEN DEFECTS, both confined to the SECONDARY B-RETRO-LONG-DT channel: (1) parent_window() uses strptime pattern %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ but the frozen parent provenance.json records scored_run_started=2026-10-17T00:45:32.184Z with fractional seconds, so it raises ValueError; (2) even with a tolerant read, the frozen retro gate computes dt_h = (rec.t_start - p_end)/3600 where rec.t_start is a time.monotonic() reading and p_end is a POSIX epoch value, mixing two clocks and producing a -497831.61 h median window. Consequence: the secondary channel is NOT ADMITTED by its own frozen gate and the days-to-weeks band stays undecided, exactly as the frozen design permits (prereg.md#11 step 6). This does not touch the primary label.

The retro channel WAS nevertheless executed in a separate, clearly-labelled pass (292 parent reference pages re-fetched, 0 byte changes, max per-host change rate 0.00 so not negotiation-suspected) and is reported in derived/retro_secondary.json and raw/retro.jsonl as a non-decisional secondary observation only.

REPRESENTATION LOSS (V11, load-bearing): no JavaScript is executed, so client-rendered content is NOT measured; HTML attributes are invisible on the primary channel by construction (quantified: 7 attr-only changes); bodies are truncated at 8 MB (M-N-TRUNCATED=0); one egress vantage, one runner, credential-free GET-only, server-rendered HTML; the frame is four documentation hosts reached by same-host <a> navigation only and is not a sample of the Web.

WINDOW SCOPE: the certification holds only at the measured separation (median 407.97 s, max 439.83 s). It is not a claim about the days-to-weeks band, about JavaScript-rendered or authenticated content, or about any other egress vantage (CC-B, prereg.md#17 items 1, 2, 9).

POWER CEILING: with n_deep=686 and n_shallow=421 and zero events, the exact one-sided contrast cannot detect a deep-stratum excess below M-CONCENTRATION-MDC-RATE=0.011662. M-CONCENTRATION-DETECTED=false therefore bounds concentration at ~1.17%, it is not an absence of concentration (prereg.md#13, #17 item 8).

CONFOUNDING: hop depth remains partly confounded with host and URL class even though all four hosts span both strata and neither stratum is version-pinned-ceilinged (deep 3.21%, shallow 0.24% VERSION_PINNED). M-HOST-TABLE is reported so the reader can see per-host n and k.
CLAIM CEILING: C-WEB-DYNAMICS stays HYPOTHESIS (CC-C); this packet produces a bounded page-class measurement, not evidence of predictive dynamical structure, and the producer does not self-promote.
NO PRODUCT PROMOTION: the certified tolerance is a session-scale bound for a declared page class and is not a shipped freshness mechanism (CC-B, spec.json#product_consequence_positive).

PREREGISTRATION TIMING (V12): no two-observation pair existed at freeze time; DESIGN probes fetched every frame URL at most once, and this transaction (2026-10-17T15:10Z) is the first and only two-observation diff on this frame.
unresolved: The frozen B-RETRO-LONG-DT channel remains unusable until the module parent_window() timestamp pattern and the monotonic-vs-epoch dt_h computation are repaired; it is the only route in this design to a window two orders of magnitude longer than the in-process separation, so the days-to-weeks band is still undecided. Smallest unblocking action: a DESIGN-stage correction of parse() to accept fractional seconds and of the retro dt_h to use a POSIX epoch clock, re-frozen and re-run.
Whether the product should adopt 1 %, 2 % or 5 % as the tolerance is a Product decision; this packet certifies only what the data support (prereg.md#20).
Whether a hop-depth-stratified guard or one global TTL is the better architecture depends on how often hop>=3 state is actually reused, which this packet does not measure (prereg.md#20).
The days-to-weeks band, JavaScript-rendered pages, authenticated pages and additional egress vantages remain open (prereg.md#17 items 1, 2, 9).

The 359 pairs whose ETag/Last-Modified moved while their canonical text did not are unexplained by this packet: they could be weak/misconfigured validators, per-request cache-busting tokens, or edge routing differences. Their cause is not identified here and M-CHANGE-TRANSPORT-* is a covariate only by frozen design (B-TRANSPORT-CHANNEL).
C-FRESHNESS guard calibration (owner lanes graph/runtime/product) consumes the certified tolerances but is out of scope for this packet.
